from fractions import Fraction
import random, math

N = 60  # truncation size; columns j>=3 repeat the same pattern (shifted)

def B(x):
    n = len(x)
    out = [x[1]]
    for k in range(2, n):
        out.append(x[k] - x[k-1])
    out.append(-x[n-1])  # x_{n+1}=0 in truncation
    return out

def l2sq(v):
    return sum(Fraction(a)*Fraction(a) for a in v)

# Column norms squared (exact)
col = []
for j in range(N):
    e = [0]*N
    e[j] = 1
    col.append(l2sq(B(e)))
print("column norm^2 values:", sorted(set(col)))
mx = max(col)
print("max column norm^2 =", mx, "=> ||B|| = sqrt(%s) ~ %.6f" % (mx, math.sqrt(mx)))
# For l1 -> l2, norm = sup over l1 unit ball of convex function = max at extreme points +-e_j,
# so norm = max column l2 norm (exact argument via triangle inequality: ||Bx|| <= sum|x_j| ||Be_j||).

# Boundedness: ||Bx||_2 <= sqrt2 * ||x||_1 for all x; sample check
worst = 0.0
random.seed(1)
for _ in range(20000):
    x = [random.uniform(-1, 1) if random.random() < 0.3 else 0 for _ in range(N)]
    s = sum(abs(a) for a in x)
    if s == 0:
        continue
    y = B(x)
    r = math.sqrt(sum(a*a for a in y)) / s
    worst = max(worst, r)
print("sampled max ratio:", worst, "(sqrt2 =", math.sqrt(2), ")")

claimed = math.sqrt(5)
if mx == 2 and worst <= math.sqrt(2) + 1e-12 and abs(math.sqrt(mx) - claimed) > 1e-9:
    print("B is bounded, true norm = sqrt(2); claimed sqrt(5) is wrong")
    print("CHECK FAIL")
elif abs(math.sqrt(mx) - claimed) < 1e-9:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
